knobs.note: Read by bin/gh-quota-sustained-alert.sh as ${GH_QUOTA_ALERT:-1}; 0 stops the lane before it reads the ledger or writes anything.
Read by bin/gh-quota-sustained-alert.sh as ${GH_QUOTA_ALERT_PCT:-60}: an hour is over when an App bucket's counted requests * 100 >= this * its limit. Not an integer in 1..100 falls back to 60.

Read by bin/gh-quota-sustained-alert.sh as ${GH_QUOTA_ALERT_HOURS:-3}: how many complete UTC hours in a row the bucket must be over before the once-a-day ALERTS.log line. Not an integer in 1..24 falls back to 3.

Read by bin/gh-quota-sustained-alert.sh as ${GH_QUOTA_ALERT_LIMIT:-7050}: the App bucket's hourly limit when the fleet ledger rows of that bucket and hour carry no positive limit_max (GitHub's X-RateLimit-Limit). Not a positive integer falls back to 7050.
Read by bin/gh-quota-sustained-alert.sh as ${GH_QUOTA_ALERT_MARKER_DAYS:-30}: day markers in state/gh-quota-alert/ older than this many days are deleted. Not a positive integer falls back to 30.
Read by bin/gh-quota-sustained-alert.sh as ${GH_QUOTA_ALERT_NOW:-$(date -u +%s)}: the epoch the lane treats as now. A test seam, so NOT settable from the control plane.
